home.pillText: Local outreach, anywhere in the world
home.title: Reach thousands of <hl>local</hl> businesses, automatically.
home.subtitle: Prospectigo finds the businesses in your area, locates their contact form and drops your message in it. You pick the area and the trade, Prospectigo handles the rest.
home.howSubtitle: Three steps, and your outreach runs on its own.
home.step1: A city and its surroundings, a list of cities or a whole country. Then the trades you care about: restaurants, plumbers, real-estate agencies…
home.step2: It searches the businesses in your area, visits every website, finds the contact form and the e-mail address. Chains and businesses without a website can be skipped.
home.step3: Your personalised message is dropped into every form, at your pace, with a screenshot as proof.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to prospect at scale
home.featuresSubtitle: No lists to buy, no copy-paste, no mailbox to connect.
home.feature1Label: Every business in an area, worldwide
home.feature1: Every business in an area, with its website, phone, rating and review count.
home.feature2: Prospectigo finds the contact form, even behind a button or a cookie banner, and fills it like a human would.
home.feature3: Up to four message variants, with the company name, city or trade inserted automatically.
home.feature4: Autopilot by default, or form-by-form approval with a screenshot: your call.
home.feature5: A different sender per campaign when needed, invite your team, export businesses as CSV.
home.feature6: When a website shows a contact address, Prospectigo collects it for your follow-ups.
home.controlTitle: You see everything, you decide everything.
home.controlText: Let the autopilot send for you, or check each filled-in form before it goes out. The sending pace is set campaign by campaign.
home.pricingSubtitle: Growth for a single business, Business and Scale for agencies.
home.pricingNote1: Prospectigo finds the businesses in your area, then keeps only the ones that match your target. Each business kept costs 1 credit, contacting included: sending the form costs nothing more, and businesses set aside are free.
home.pricingNote2Label: Hard targets: 2 or 4 credits per business
home.pricingNote2: When only a small share of the businesses found match your target, Prospectigo has to review many more of them for each business kept. The price is measured automatically at the start of the campaign: 1 credit if at least 25% of the businesses match, 2 credits between 12 and 25%, 4 credits between 6 and 12%. Below 6%, the campaign pauses and asks you to make your target more precise.
home.pricingNote3: Your credits are used at the pace you choose, campaign by campaign. They renew every month. On the yearly plan you pay 10 months for 12.
home.pricingNote4: Plans are billed in euros in Europe and in US dollars elsewhere, by card, with no commitment. Change plans or cancel anytime from your billing settings.

faqItems.q1: Which countries does Prospectigo work in?
faqItems.a1: Anywhere in the world: you pick a city and its surroundings, a list of cities or a whole country, in the country of your choice.
faqItems.a2: Through the contact form on the business's website, filled in by Prospectigo. Nothing leaves your mailbox. When an e-mail address is found on the site, it is shown to you as well.
faqItems.a3: Your plan gives you credits every month (15,000, 40,000 or 100,000). Each business kept for your campaign costs 1 credit (2 or 4 for hard targets, see the next question), and contacting it is included: sending the form uses no credits. Credits renew every month, with no daily cap.
faqItems.q4: Why do some campaigns cost several credits per business?
faqItems.a4: Because they take Prospectigo much more work. At the start of each campaign, Prospectigo measures the share of businesses found that match your target (over roughly the first 300). From 25%, each business kept costs 1 credit. Between 12 and 25%, 2 credits. Between 6 and 12%, 4 credits. Below 6%, the campaign pauses: make your target more precise to resume it. Businesses kept during the measurement are charged at the measured price, and a business your team has already paid for is never charged twice.
faqItems.q5: Can I review messages before they go out?
faqItems.a5: Yes. By default, the autopilot sends your messages for you, and can show you the first 3 filled-in forms before it starts. In advanced mode, every prepared form is shown with a screenshot: you approve or skip it.
faqItems.q6: I run an agency, can I manage several clients?
faqItems.a6: Yes. Add one sender per client and pick it in each campaign. Invite teammates up to your plan's seat count.
faqItems.a7: No. Plans are monthly or yearly and can be cancelled anytime from your billing settings.
